name: Nyungwe National Park
description: Nyungwe National Park blankets about 1,000 square kilometres of southwestern Rwanda along the Burundi border, and is probably Africa's best-preserved montane rainforest. Mist-wrapped slopes rise to the 2,921-metre summit of Mount Bigugu, with bogs, bamboo and grassland in between. Visitors come to look for chimpanzees and golden monkeys, and the 317 recorded bird species make it a major draw for birdwatchers.
